analyze_job_metrics: analyze a completed autoresearch job by collecting metrics and running agent analysis on the results
append_master_result_row: append a new result row to the master table with metrics and failure notes for a completed node
update_on_complete: update the autoresearch state history and current best metric after a hypothesis node completes
record_successful_structural_practices: record structural practice tags as tried in state when experiments succeed or reach attempt threshold
update_summary_and_plot: regenerate the summary markdown file and progress and hypothesis tree plots from current state
